summary_en: WELLNEO SUGAR will acquire up to 9,900 shares (0.03% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 31.0 million yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between October 1 and 14, 2026, to secure shares for allocation to an employee stock ownership plan linked to a merger with its wholly-owned subsidiary.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Treasury Share Acquisition (Acquisition of Treasury Shares Based on Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
WELLNEO SUGAR announced on September 29, 2026, the acquisition of treasury shares to support an employee stock ownership plan in connection with a planned merger with its wholly-owned subsidiary, Toyo Seito Co., Ltd., scheduled for October 1, 2026.

The company will acquire up to 9,900 ordinary shares representing 0.03% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury shares) for a maximum purchase price of 31.0 million yen. The acquisition will be executed through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange over the period from October 1 to October 14, 2026.

The shares will be secured and subsequently allocated to the Employee Stock Ownership Association under a special incentive program designed to boost employee motivation toward enhanced corporate value in conjunction with the merger. As of August 31, 2026, the company held 2,172 treasury shares against 32,797,923 outstanding shares excluding treasury shares.
